Every line in this file is a thing lindo-md must NOT do something clever with.

# This is not a heading
## Nor is this

*not emphasis*  _not emphasis either_  **not bold**  `not code`

- [ ] not a task list
- not a bullet

1. not an ordered list

> not a block quote

| not | a | table |
| --- | - | ----- |

[not a link](https://example.com)  ![not an image](a.png)

```
not a fenced code block
```

--- not a horizontal rule, and not frontmatter either

$$ not math $$

[^1]: not a footnote

<script>alert("not a script")</script>
<b>not bold markup</b> & an ampersand < a less-than > a greater-than

	a leading tab
    four leading spaces
